div.h1: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider — Singapore (Modules 1–3)

p.strong: Aug 2026 – Feb 2027 · Module 1: 29–30 Aug · Module 2: 26–27 Sep · Module 3: 20–21 Feb 2027 · Singapore (venue confirmed on registration) · In-Person + online sessions

div.p: With Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer

Transform your practice. Empower others. The complete Global TRE™ Provider Certification with Isabelle Claus Teixeira — three modules that take you from your own TRE™ practice to confidently teaching TRE™ to individuals and groups.

The Global TRE™ Provider Certification prepares you to teach TRE™ safely, responsibly and professionally. Certified Providers are qualified to offer TRE™ to the general public in both individual and group settings.

The journey is three modules — each a 2-day workshop plus 4 online sessions — taking you from your own personal TRE™ practice (Module 1), to teaching one person (Module 2), to confidently leading groups (Module 3).
You train under Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer, accredited by TRE™ for All under Dr. David Berceli's methodology. Module 1 is also available online.

ul.li: A coach (ACC, PCC, MCC or in training) wanting somatic tools
A therapist, counsellor or psychologist seeking body-based approaches
An HR, wellbeing or corporate resilience professional
A yoga teacher, physiotherapist or movement practitioner
Someone who has experienced TRE™ and wants to share it professionally

Module 1 29–30 Aug 2026 · Singapore · SGT — Your Personal TRE™ Practice — 2-day workshop + 4 online personal TRE™ sessions. The stress response (anatomy, neurology, physiology), the therapeutic tremor response, TRE™ as a self-practice, self-regulation, containment and grounding. Includes 21 ICF CCEUs.

Module 2 26–27 Sep 2026 · Singapore · SGT — Teaching TRE™ to One Person — 2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. Open to those who completed Module 1. Deepens Module 1 content, Polyvagal theory, basic TRE™ interventions and hands-on practice teaching TRE™ one-to-one.

Module 3 20–21 Feb 2027 · Singapore · SGT — Teaching TRE™ to Groups — 2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. The role of fascia, advanced interventions and modifications, transference and counter-transference, and experience leading groups of 3+ persons. Completes your certification.
Three 2-day workshops — Modules 1, 2 & 3 in Singapore (Module 1 also online)
12 online sessions — 4 personal TRE™ sessions + 8 supervision sessions with Isabelle
21 ICF CCEUs on Module 1 — the only TRE™ training in the world with ICF accreditation
All training materials and manual — plus ongoing mentorship through completion
Global TRE™ Provider certificate — issued by TRE™ for All on qualification
Global provider network — join the TRE™ for All community of practitioners worldwide
Full Certification Journey (Modules 1, 2 & 3 · three 2-day workshops + 12 online sessions) — S$3,699 — super early bird · early bird S$4,200 · normal S$4,500
Module 1 only · face-to-face (2-day workshop + 4 online personal TRE™ sessions · 21 ICF CCEUs) — S$1,290 — super early bird · early bird S$1,500 · normal S$1,800
Module 1 only · online (Live online workshop + 4 online personal TRE™ sessions) — S$990 — early bird · normal S$1,190

div.p: All prices in Singapore Dollars. Early-bird deadlines are relative to the Module 1 start date. All tickets are non-refundable and non-cancellable.

ul.li: Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC. Somatic and trauma-informed Executive Coach (ICF PCC), Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Mindfulness Teacher. Trained directly under Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Over 30 years of experience working with professionals, executives and teams across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities — in person and online.
